title: Optional Observer Desktop Integration
summary: Keep desktop status and management controls as optional adapters around the local Observer and Core contracts. Platform-specific setup and update capabilities are documented separately.

ownership.core: Owns profile selection, indexing, retrieval, and evidence schemas.
ownership.observer: Owns local source observation, state, and explicit delivery.
ownership.desktop: Owns user-facing status, command dispatch, and display of typed results.

interaction.statusView: Show selected route, observation age, queue state, and typed errors.
interaction.queryView: Context retrieval is available through CLI and MCP. The current Monitor displays readiness, projects, activity and settings; it does not provide an interactive source-query view.
interaction.actions: Project enrollment, agent configuration, storage cleanup, profile approval and update installation remain explicit operations. Available graphical actions differ by platform; Windows currently checks releases and opens download links without installing them.

safety: Closing a window does not imply source mutation or queue acknowledgement.
A displayed result preserves its freshness and verification labels.
Desktop code does not implement a second ranking or authorization policy.
The desktop adapter remains optional to portable Core.
verificationBoundary: UI fixtures verify control behavior and rendering only; they do not qualify a deployed service or real project corpus.
